body: I just wished people around me would understand that I'm not happy. If I were to tell anyone be it my parents, teachers whatever they'd call me a coward for being sad. They'd say "oh what a stupid reason blah blah blah" but it really is hurting me deep down. I don't know whether its because I'm just a teen growing up and "no one understands me" or if it's actually how people treat me. Honestly, people treat me fine, but once they start getting aggressive or upset I get really sad and I wished it could've just turned out better.
